description: From outside Vesting Bourtange the moat reflects a grass-covered earthen bastion, and a wooden bridge leads to the brick gate. The sails of the mill inside the fort show above the rampart. The whole star plan is only partly visible from the ground. It is clear and the coolest of this group, about 9.7°C, with wind near 9.7 km/h. Sunset was 19:20. The village inside is quiet.
